questions.topic: Safety in Auto Parts Merchandising Shop
questions.stem: Which fire extinguisher is suitable for a fire involving engine oil and lubricants in an auto parts store?
questions.explanation: Oil fires are smothered by foam or dry powder; water spreads burning oil.

questions.stem: A customer asks for the rings fitted in the lowest groove of a petrol engine piston. These are the
questions.explanation: The lower ring scrapes excess oil from the cylinder wall; the upper rings seal compression.

questions.stem: In the clutch assembly, the part that is pressed by the clutch fork to disengage the clutch is the
questions.explanation: The fork moves the release bearing against the diaphragm fingers or levers to withdraw the pressure plate.

questions.stem: One function of the gearbox is to
options: support the weight of the vehicle
provide a reverse gear so the vehicle can move backwards
questions.explanation: The gearbox provides different ratios, neutral and reverse; it does not cool oil or carry weight.

questions.topic: Transmission System (Propeller Shaft and Rear Axle Assembly)
questions.stem: The joint on the propeller shaft that allows the shaft length to change as the rear axle moves up and down is the
questions.explanation: The splined slip joint allows length change; the universal joint allows angle change.

questions.stem: A steel bar that twists to act as a spring in some suspension systems is called a
questions.explanation: A torsion bar is a spring that resists twisting; tie rods and drag links belong to the steering.

questions.stem: Which of these is a part of an AIR cooling system rather than a water cooling system?
questions.explanation: Air-cooled engines use fins and a fan/cowling; radiators and water pumps are for water cooling.

questions.stem: The rods that connect the steering gearbox or rack to the steering arms on the wheels are the
questions.explanation: Tie rods transmit steering movement to the wheel hubs; push rods and connecting rods are engine parts.

questions.stem: A customer asks for a multigrade engine oil. Which of the following should the seller supply?
questions.explanation: Multigrade oils carry two numbers (cold and hot grades); SAE 40 and SAE 60 are monogrades and grease is not engine oil.

questions.stem: The electronic control unit, often called the "brain box" by Nigerian mechanics, is used to
options: receive signals from sensors and control injection, ignition and other systems
questions.explanation: The ECU processes sensor inputs and commands actuators such as injectors and the ignition.

questions.stem: In older vehicles fitted with a dynamo, the cut-out was used to
options: cut off fuel when the engine overheats
prevent the battery discharging back through the dynamo when the engine is slow or stopped
limit the current to the starter motor
questions.explanation: When dynamo voltage falls below battery voltage the cut-out opens; alternators use diodes for the same purpose.

questions.stem: A tyre size is marked 205/55 R16. Which statement is correct?
options: The rim diameter is 205 mm and the width is 55 mm
The tyre is 55% wider than it is high and fits a 205 mm rim
The sidewall height is 205 mm and the rim is 16 cm
The section width is 205 mm and the sidewall height is about 112.8 mm
questions.explanation: 205 is the width in mm, 55 is the aspect ratio (height = 55% of 205 = 112.75 mm), R is radial and 16 is the rim diameter in inches.

questions.topic: Types of Tools and Their Uses
questions.stem: Which of the following is a SPECIAL tool rather than a general tool?
questions.explanation: Pullers and extractors are made for particular jobs; screwdrivers, pliers and spanners are general tools.

questions.stem: Leaving spanners and sockets wet and unoiled on the floor of a shop will MOST likely result in
options: rusting and early damage to the tools
questions.explanation: Moisture causes rust and lost tools cause accidents; tools should be cleaned, lightly oiled and stored.

questions.stem: The test instrument used to measure the carbon monoxide and hydrocarbon content of exhaust gases is the
questions.explanation: The gas analyser samples the tailpipe gases; the dwell meter measures how long contact points stay closed.

questions.stem: Before operating a new engine analyser for the first time, the shop attendant should
options: open the case to check the circuit board
read the manufacturer's manual for start-up, operation and shut-down
connect it directly to the mains without checking voltage
test it on a running engine without the leads
questions.explanation: The manual gives correct start-up and shut-down procedures and care instructions, preventing damage.

questions.stem: Which of these is an ACCESSORY rather than an essential working part of a car?
questions.explanation: Accessories add comfort, protection or appearance (seat covers, wheel covers, car radio); the others are needed for the car to work.

questions.stem: Heavy parts such as brake drums and crankshafts should be stored
options: on the lower shelves of strong racks
on the floor near the doorway
questions.explanation: Storing heavy items low reduces the risk of injury when lifting and of shelves collapsing; doorways must be kept clear.

questions.stem: When using a manufacturer's parts catalogue, the FIRST information needed to locate the correct part for a customer's car is usually the
options: vehicle make, model and year or chassis (VIN) number
questions.explanation: Catalogues are arranged by make, model and production period; the VIN identifies the exact specification.

questions.stem: A shop sells at most 12 oil filters a day and the supplier takes at most 8 days to deliver. Using re-order level = maximum usage x maximum lead time, the re-order level is
questions.explanation: ROL = 12 x 8 = 96; when stock falls to this level a new order is placed so the shop does not run out before delivery.

questions.stem: A shop bought 50 spark plugs at ₦2,000 each and later 30 more at ₦2,400 each. It then sold 60 plugs. Using FIFO, the cost of the plugs sold is
questions.explanation: FIFO issues the oldest stock first: 50 x 2,000 + 10 x 2,400 = ₦124,000. LIFO would give ₦132,000.

questions.stem: Arranging all Toyota parts in one section and all Honda parts in another section of the shop is presentation by
questions.explanation: Grouping by make or model helps customers and staff find parts quickly.

questions.stem: The card kept with each bin or shelf to record receipts, issues and balance of a part is the
questions.explanation: A bin card shows the running balance of stock at the storage location, used during inventory taking.

questions.stem: Product sourcing in an auto parts business means
options: finding reliable suppliers who can provide genuine parts at the right price and time
questions.explanation: Sourcing is locating and choosing suppliers, locally or abroad, for quality, price and delivery.

questions.stem: A sale in which the customer takes the parts now and pays at an agreed later date is a
questions.explanation: Credit (deferred) sales allow later payment; cash sales are paid for immediately.

questions.stem: An invoice sent by a parts dealer in Ladipo market to a mechanic shows
options: only the name of the seller
the weight of the goods only
the goods supplied, quantities, prices, total amount and terms of payment
questions.explanation: An invoice is a bill giving details of goods, prices, totals and terms; it is used to record credit sales.

questions.stem: An invoice lists 4 sets of brake pads at ₦8,500 per set, less 10% trade discount. The amount due on the invoice is
questions.explanation: Gross = ₦34,000; trade discount = ₦3,400; net = ₦30,600.

questions.stem: An auto parts dealer studies last year's sales to estimate how many batteries to stock for the harmattan season. This is
questions.explanation: Forecasting predicts future demand from past data and expected conditions.

questions.stem: The book in which a business records all cash received and cash paid is the
questions.explanation: The cash book records cash and bank receipts and payments; journals record credit transactions.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an EXTERNAL source of finance for a new auto parts shop?
options: Profit ploughed back into the business
A loan from a microfinance bank
Sale of the shop's old equipment
questions.explanation: Loans come from outside the business; savings, retained profit and sale of assets are internal.

questions.stem: Dividing customers into groups such as commercial bus owners, private car owners and motorcycle riders is called
questions.explanation: Segmentation groups customers with similar needs so the seller can target each group.

questions.stem: A shock absorber costs the dealer ₦15,000. If the dealer adds a mark-up of 30% on cost, the selling price is
questions.explanation: Selling price = 15,000 x 1.30 = ₦19,500; dividing by 0.7 would give a 30% margin on selling price instead.

questions.stem: Value pricing means setting the price of a part mainly according to
options: the benefit and worth the customer places on it
the weight of the part only
the price charged by the cheapest seller in another country
questions.explanation: Value pricing bases price on perceived customer value (e.g. genuine vs fake part quality), not only on cost.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a medium of advertising?
questions.explanation: Radio, television, newspapers, billboards and social media are advertising media.

questions.stem: A customer returns angrily saying the wrong bulb was sold. The BEST first action of the sales attendant is to
options: argue that the customer chose the bulb
ask the customer to leave the shop
listen calmly, apologise and check the receipt and part
questions.explanation: Good complaint handling starts with listening and verifying; arguing loses customers.

questions.stem: A customer may LOSE the warranty right on a new alternator if
options: the fault is reported within the warranty period
the part was bought from an authorised dealer
it was fitted wrongly or tampered with contrary to the instructions
questions.explanation: Warranties exclude misuse, wrong installation and tampering; keeping the receipt and reporting on time preserve the right.

questions.stem: The Nigerian government agency responsible for setting and enforcing quality standards for products, including imported auto parts, is the
questions.explanation: SON sets and enforces product standards to stop substandard parts; FRSC deals with road safety.

questions.stem: Auto parts merchandising is best defined as
options: the buying, display and selling of vehicle parts and accessories to make a profit
questions.explanation: Merchandising covers planning, buying, presenting and selling goods to customers.

questions.stem: Which quality is MOST important for an auto parts seller dealing with customers?
questions.explanation: Honest sellers build trust and repeat customers; the other traits drive customers away.

questions.stem: Which of these is UNETHICAL behaviour by an auto parts seller?
options: Issuing a receipt for every sale
Explaining warranty terms to the buyer
Charging fair prices displayed on tags
Selling a fake brake pad as a genuine part
questions.explanation: Passing off counterfeit parts as genuine is dishonest and endangers lives, especially for safety parts like brakes.

questions.stem:
(a) Name five engine parts sold in an auto parts shop and state the location of each in the engine. [10 marks]
(b) State the function of each of the following: (i) piston (ii) connecting rod (iii) camshaft (iv) valves (v) oil pump. [10 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
10 marks: (a) Any five, 2 marks each (1 name + 1 location): piston - inside the cylinder; piston rings - grooves of the piston; connecting rod - between piston and crankshaft; crankshaft - lower part of the cylinder block/crankcase; camshaft - in the block or cylinder head; valves - in the cylinder head; oil pump - in the crankcase/sump, driven by the engine; cylinder head - bolted on top of the block
2 marks: (b)(i) Piston: receives force of the burning gases and transmits it to the connecting rod; draws in and compresses charge
2 marks: (b)(ii) Connecting rod: connects piston to crankshaft, transmitting force and converting reciprocating to rotary motion
2 marks: (b)(iii) Camshaft: opens the valves at the correct time (and may drive distributor/fuel pump)
2 marks: (b)(iv) Valves: open and close the ports to admit charge and release exhaust gases; seal the combustion chamber
2 marks: (b)(v) Oil pump: circulates oil under pressure to bearings and moving parts
questions.explanation: Piston (cylinder), rings (piston grooves), connecting rod (piston to crank), crankshaft (crankcase), camshaft (block/head), valves (head), oil pump (sump). Piston transmits gas force; connecting rod converts motion; camshaft opens valves; valves control gas flow; oil pump circulates oil under pressure.

questions.stem:
(a) Distinguish between disc brakes and drum brakes. [4 marks]
(b) List six parts of a hydraulic braking system and state the function of each. [12 marks]
(c) State four precautions a parts seller should advise a customer to take when buying brake parts. [4 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
2 marks: (a) Disc brake: pads clamp a rotating disc attached to the hub, using a caliper
2 marks: (a) Drum brake: shoes with linings expand against the inside of a rotating drum, using a wheel cylinder
12 marks: (b) Any six, 2 marks each (1 name + 1 function): master cylinder - converts pedal force to fluid pressure; wheel cylinder - pushes shoes against drum; caliper - pushes pads against disc; brake pipes/hoses - carry fluid; brake pads - friction on disc; brake shoes/linings - friction in drum; brake fluid - transmits pressure; reservoir - stores fluid; return springs - pull shoes back
4 marks: (c) Any four, 1 mark each: buy genuine parts from reputable dealers; match the part number to the vehicle model; check packaging/standards marks (SON); use the recommended brake fluid grade; keep the receipt for warranty; avoid used/reconditioned safety parts
questions.explanation: Disc: caliper pads grip a disc; drum: shoes expand inside a drum. Parts: master cylinder, wheel cylinders, calipers, pipes, pads, shoes, fluid, reservoir, springs, each with its function. Advise genuine parts, matching part numbers, correct fluid, standards marks and receipts.

questions.stem:
(a) Explain the meaning of re-order level and state two advantages of keeping correct stock levels. [4 marks]
(b) A shop received 40 fan belts at ₦1,500 each on 2 May and 60 fan belts at ₦1,800 each on 9 May. On 20 May it sold 70 fan belts. Calculate: (i) the cost of the belts sold using FIFO; (ii) the value of closing stock using FIFO; (iii) the cost of the belts sold using LIFO; (iv) the value of closing stock using LIFO. [12 marks]
(c) State two factors that determine the re-order quantity. [4 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
2 marks: (a) Re-order level: the stock level at which a fresh order must be placed so that new stock arrives before the existing stock runs out
2 marks: (a) Any two, 1 mark each: avoids stock-outs and lost sales; avoids overstocking and tied-up capital; reduces storage cost/deterioration; ensures continuous service to customers
3 marks: (b)(i) FIFO cost of sales = 40 x 1,500 + 30 x 1,800 = 60,000 + 54,000 = ₦114,000
3 marks: (b)(ii) FIFO closing stock = 30 x 1,800 = ₦54,000
3 marks: (b)(iii) LIFO cost of sales = 60 x 1,800 + 10 x 1,500 = 108,000 + 15,000 = ₦123,000
3 marks: (b)(iv) LIFO closing stock = 30 x 1,500 = ₦45,000
4 marks: (c) Any two, 2 marks each: rate of usage/demand; lead time; storage space; capital available; ordering and holding costs; discounts for bulk buying; shelf life of the part
questions.explanation: ROL is the stock level that triggers a new order. FIFO: cost of sales ₦114,000, closing stock ₦54,000. LIFO: cost of sales ₦123,000, closing stock ₦45,000. Total value ₦168,000 is the same either way. Re-order quantity depends on demand, lead time, space, capital, costs and discounts.

questions.stem:
(a) Name five types of business records kept by an auto parts merchandiser. [5 marks]
(b) State the use of each record named in (a). [5 marks]
(c) Give five reasons why a parts dealer should keep proper records. [10 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
5 marks: (a) Any five, 1 mark each: sales journal; purchases journal; sales ledger; purchases ledger; cash book; invoice; receipt; bin/stock card
5 marks: (b) 1 mark each, matched to (a): sales journal - lists credit sales; purchases journal - lists credit purchases; sales ledger - accounts of debtors; purchases ledger - accounts of creditors; cash book - cash and bank receipts/payments; invoice - bill for goods supplied; receipt - proof of payment; bin card - stock balance
10 marks: (c) Any five, 2 marks each: to know profit or loss; to know debtors and creditors; to control stock and detect theft; to support loan applications; for tax assessment; for planning and forecasting; to settle disputes with customers/suppliers
questions.explanation: Records: sales and purchases journals, ledgers, cash book, invoices, receipts, bin cards, each recording a part of trading. They show profit, debts, stock, and support loans, tax, planning and dispute resolution.

questions.stem:
(a) Define fund raising as it applies to an auto parts business. [2 marks]
(b) Distinguish between internal and external sources of finance, giving two examples of each. [8 marks]
(c) Describe the procedure for obtaining a bank loan to expand an auto parts shop. [10 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
2 marks: (a) The process of obtaining money (capital) to start, run or expand the business
4 marks: (b) Internal: funds generated from within the business/owner (2); examples - personal savings, retained profit, sale of unused assets (any two, 2)
4 marks: (b) External: funds from outside the business (2); examples - bank loan, microfinance loan, cooperative society, trade credit, family/friends, government grants, partners (any two, 2)
10 marks: (c) 2 marks each, any five steps in logical order: open/maintain an account with the bank; prepare a business plan showing purpose and repayment ability; fill loan application form; provide collateral/guarantors and documents (CAC registration, statements); bank appraises and approves; sign loan agreement; loan disbursed and repaid by instalments
questions.explanation: Fund raising is obtaining capital. Internal sources come from the owner or business (savings, retained profit); external from outside (bank and microfinance loans, cooperatives, trade credit). A bank loan needs an account, a business plan, application, collateral/guarantors and documents, appraisal, agreement, disbursement and repayment.

questions.stem:
(a) Explain the meaning of customer service. [2 marks]
(b) State four types of customer service an auto parts shop can offer. [4 marks]
(c) Describe the steps for handling a customer's complaint about a faulty part. [8 marks]
(d) State three importance of a warranty to a buyer of auto parts. [6 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
2 marks: (a) All the assistance and activities a seller provides before, during and after a sale to satisfy customers
4 marks: (b) Any four, 1 mark each: advice on correct parts; delivery; fitting/installation; after-sales service; credit facilities; warranty/replacement; telephone orders; courteous reception
8 marks: (c) 2 marks each, any four steps: listen patiently without interrupting; apologise and show empathy; check receipt and inspect the part/verify fault; offer a solution - replace, repair or refund according to policy/warranty; record the complaint and follow up to ensure satisfaction
6 marks: (d) Any three, 2 marks each: assures buyer of quality; free repair or replacement if defective within the period; protects buyer from loss; builds confidence in the seller; may increase resale value
questions.explanation: Customer service is the help given before, during and after a sale. Types: advice, delivery, fitting, after-sales support, credit, warranty. Complaints: listen, apologise, verify, resolve, follow up. Warranty assures quality, gives free repair/replacement and protects the buyer.
